title: What costroid version --json prints, version 0.1
description: What a bug report needs about one costroid binary and the directory it ran in. It holds no secret, no value of the environment and no path but the name of the configuration file.

release.description: The release the binary belongs to, or dev for a build of no release.

commit.description: The commit the binary was built from. Null for a build that records none.

os.description: The operating system the binary was built for, as Go names it.

arch.description: The architecture the binary was built for, as Go names it.

version.description: The price catalog the binary carries.

prices_read.description: The day its prices were read. Null when its sheets state none.

result_schemas.description: The versions of the result object this release writes, oldest first.

config.description: Whether the directory the command ran in holds the configuration file.
